defects.detail: The scene includes 40 identical individual actors, which is not the smallest causally sufficient world. A single collective actor 'Procurement Leads' would suffice, as the question only cares about at least one agreeing, not which one.
All 40 procurement leads are identical and interchangeable; 39 of them are decorative because the question only requires at least one to agree. A single collective actor would be sufficient.
